subject: Latency surge: remediation matrix and executive briefing prep
messages:
From: Claire O'Lee <claire@fastretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fastretail.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden latency and errors on checkout (US-west)

Karthik —

We're seeing a sustained latency spike and an increase in 5xx errors across our checkout routes since ~07:30 PT. P50/90 token latency is up ~3-4x, and our downstream queueing is building. This is live revenue impact. Team captured a small sample (attached).

Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm whether this is a platform regression or traffic pattern change on our side?
- ETA on mitigation if it's on Redwood?
- We may need an executive note for our leadership (they're asking now).

Attachments: fastretail_latency_snapshot_0423.csv (sample traces)

Thanks,
Claire O'Lee
Head of Engineering, FastRetail
claire@fastretail.com

-----

Note: forwarded to procurement for context and billing impact
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire O'Lee <claire@fastretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden latency and errors on checkout (US-west)

Claire —

Thanks for the sample and the alert. We're on it. Quick summary of immediate steps:
1) Opened an incident bridge with infra and serving runtime teams (Jonas + Soojin leading).
2) Short-term mitigation: routing a fraction of traffic to a lower-latency model variant in us-west while we diagnose.
3) Collecting traces and KV cache metrics — please expect a 10–15 minute window for the first telemetry dump.

I've looped Marissa for customer communication and exec escalation if needed. We'll follow up with a remediation matrix within the hour and a proposed timeline for a permanent fix. If you can share any recent traffic/prompt-set changes that started before 07:30, that would help.

Karthik
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden latency and errors on checkout (US-west)

Team —

Incident update (first-90m triage):
- Root suspicion: a degraded kernel path in our latest runtime patch when sequence lengths exceed 2k tokens under continuous batching. The telemetry shows CPU/GPU stalls aligned to large KV cache misses.
- Scope: ~7% of FastRetail's traffic (mostly long-prompts in cart price-summaries) — but because of queuing this weighted impact looks much higher at the edge.
- Short-term mitigations enacted:
  * Canary fallback: ~20% of checkout requests rerouted to quantized v2 model (lower memory pressure) — reduced p90 latency by ~30% in the canary.
  * Increased batch size ceiling to smooth scheduling for affected pods — minor latency improvements but risk of token-cost increase.

Next actions (I will own):
- Build remediation matrix (attached) with owners, risk, ETA.
- Revert the specific kernel selection flag in the runtime for affected clusters (risk: potential regressions in other workloads) — target: 24–36 hours for safe rollback and verification.
- Post-incident RCA draft for execs + customer-facing summary — target: EOD Monday (April 26).

Attachments: remediation_matrix_karthik_v1.xlsx

Jonas
VP, Serving Runtime

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire O'Lee <claire@fastretail.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Latency surge: remediation matrix and executive briefing prep

Claire —

Following up with the remediation commitments and the exec summary (attached). High-level:
- What happened: a runtime kernel selection regression triggered pathological KV cache behavior for long prompts (7% of traffic) which amplified queuing and elevated p90 latency.
- What we did: immediate canary fallback, temporary routing to quantized variant, and targeted kernel-flag rollback in affected clusters.
- Customer impact: estimated 2.1 hours of elevated latency between 07:30–09:42 PT on April 23; we estimate ~0.6% GMV impact for the window.
- Corrective actions (owners & ETA):
  * Jonas/Runtime: safe rollback + automated pre-deploy kernel tests (complete by Apr 26) — COMPLETE
  * Soojin/Infra: add KV cache miss alert + increased eviction headroom (complete by Apr 30) — IN PROGRESS
  * Karthik/Customer Reliability: create customer-facing post-incident brief and a 60-day monitoring commitment (draft attached) — COMPLETE
  * Marissa/Customer Success: schedule exec readout and quarterly resilience review (meeting scheduled Apr 29) — COMPLETE

Attachments: exec_summary_0428.pdf (1-page exec brief), remediation_matrix_karthik_v1.xlsx

Next steps:
- We're proposing a joint postmortem readout with your leadership on Apr 29, 11:00 PT. Please confirm whether that time works.
- We'll share a 60-day dashboard and weekly progress updates until we hit the resilience targets.

Appreciate your partnership — we'll send the full RCA package and telemetry links after the readout.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success
marissa_cole@redwood.com
